title: 본문2
source_detail: 동아(윤정미) 중2 Lesson 5 READING 본문 — 본문2
body_text: The place that we are going to visit is Shoreditch. Poor workers used to live in this area, but now it is one of the hippest areas in London. We can find so many great pieces of street art here. Do you see the painting over there? It is by the artist STIK. He is famous for using only lines and dots in his paintings of human bodies. According to STIK, the three figures represent the past, present, and future of Shoreditch. Which figure represents which? Well, look closely at the eyes of the three figures. They are just dots, but they will give you a clue.
